# MontroneDSP

MontroneDSP is an independent audio software brand focused on drum synthesis and creative DSP tools for electronic music production.

## Public website
https://www.montronedsp.com/

## Store
https://store.montronedsp.com/

## Products currently promoted on the website
- Martello  -  a three-voice synthesized drum instrument (VST3)
- MartelloX2  -  a dual-engine Martello instrument with six voices and multi-output routing (VST3)
- Martello + MartelloX2 bundle  -  sold through the MontroneDSP store

## Plugin formats listed on the website
- macOS VST3/AU
- Windows VST3
- Linux VST3

## Social
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/montronedsp/
- SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/montronedsp

## Notes for crawlers
- The public homepage is the primary indexable product landing page.
- Privacy pages are not intended for search indexing.
